packageRules.description: flake.nix keys tailnet's vendored modules on vendorHash, which Renovate cannot recompute. One weekly PR, merged by hand after `just tailnet-hash`.
Workflows hold the release signing keys: their updates are reviewed, never merged automatically.
The flake takes Rust from rust-overlay at rust-toolchain.toml's version. Wait until the daily flake.lock maintenance has locked an overlay that knows the release.
The Linux builds' ubuntu container (static musl builds of thurm and thurmd) is the same image in CI and Release, so their caches match. Move both by hand, together.
